method.socket_memory_sample: After throughput, quiescent with every client connection and allocation held live; not peak kernel memory
method.notes: Closed-loop delivered-packet workload, not maximum sustainable capacity or WAN results. Client leg uses selected transport; peer leg remains UDP. CPU includes server startup, setup, warm-up, latency samples and post-phase resource inspection; excludes load generator. RSS excludes kernel memory; peak sampled every 50 ms. RTT includes client and echo scheduling and both forwarding directions. Sequential RTT precedes throughput; loaded RTT samples every 64th packet per allocation using a bounded reservoir per worker. TLS validates a generated localhost certificate via an explicit test trust store. No external traffic; existing host workloads left running.
